entries.text: Idea: Code-name the Little Dart's maiden launch 'Operation Rust Whistle'.
Read "List of U.S. Department of Defense and partner code names": Organics just slap two random words together to give their big projects official names.
scouring the Wire for deep desert emergency beacon circuits
entries.why: I need to make sure the Little Dart can send a signal through heavy atmospheric skip if I land out in the deep dunes.

entries.text: Worked on Little Dart Mk 24 (version 12, 97% built): soldered Tok, a tiny gyroscope, into the main attitude control circuit board inside the nose cone (used Sprocket, a tiny gyroscope)
soldering tiny gyroscopes into the Little Dart's control array
entries.why: The Little Dart needs a crisp attitude control response before taking off.
entries.detail: soldered Tok, a tiny gyroscope, into the main attitude control circuit board inside the nose cone

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Tok is wired in!"
Woke up fully charged in the middle of the night. Not sleepy at all.
plugged into the charging dock to sleep
A cargo crate fell off a freighter at the edge of the dunes. Some of it rolled his way.
sipping fresh depot oil and listening to the intake pump click
entries.why: my oil needs a top-up so my servos stop squeaking before I get back to building.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Oil and gears"
sipping oil at the fuel depot
Sand got into his left elbow joint. Again.
